reviews.t: My fine hair said "THANKS and where have you been Regis Designline?
reviews.x: This is a great product and if you could see my fine hair (which I have lived with FOREVER), you would  believe me.  I use it on my wet hair, or dry hair...according to MY needs.  This is GREAT product.  If you have thin hair like me, I know you have purchased at least 99 products that either failed, or less than overwhelmed...this will make you happy...not Farrah Faucett happy, but happy.
The photo clearly shows firm hold.  The description does not say differently.  They do not send firm hold.  They do not have it.
Was supposed to be Firm hold. I recieved Natural hold.  Not happy with what I received.

This is the perfect product for fine hair! I use it in combination with the texturizing spray and hairspray. My hair is super short and spiky, so I put the mousse on prior to blow drying. Spritz on the roots for lift or directly on the hair to increase texture or to style. This is my favorite product! These products are firm hold that washes out of the hair easily. I have used many products from this line over the years and haven’t found one I don’t like. If you can buy the products locally from

Texture Tousle is more than a hairspray. It is a texturizer that is flexible enough to "construct" a hairstyle, with or without curls, so it stays where you want it. It is malleable while it's damp on dry hair. Once the spray dries, it will keep your hair in place. The one problem I have with Every. Single. Can. of TT is that the sprayer gives way after a few uses. You can mash on it all you want, and the spray will not come out. To fix that, I hold the can upside down. It's a little tricky if y

reviews.t: Love the spray, not the nozzle, it clogs
reviews.x: I love the actual product itself. Unfortunately the spray tube itself will clog so badly that I have had to throw away cans that are still 1/3-1/4 full because even with cleaning the nozzle, the tube that goes down into the can is so clogged the product can’t come out. Very disappointing

I started using Texture Tousle with my short hair 1 year ago. I was buying it at my salon until they no longer had this on the shelf. Oh no ! Thank goodness I found it online. I spray it on, lift and style my layers with my fingers. Everyone asks where do I get my hair cut..

reviews.t: Great way to manage many styles w/out stiffness!
reviews.x: Works great if, like me and how I use it, you have some areas of hair that, after using a blow dryer just to dry your normally straight shorter cut hair, there are stubborn areas where you hair has a mind of its own, and curls up/down/sideways, and you have to MAKE it behave. Or suppose, like me, the hair right at the front won’t lay back. It just hangs forward, right in your face.  A quick fritz of this will make it lay back without stiffness or a greasy feel.  Or suppose you want your hair to

reviews.t: I love that it doesn’t leave my hair crunchy
reviews.x: I picked this up w/ my last haircut. I love that it doesn’t leave my hair crunchy. It has a light hold and you can barely feel the product when you run your hands through your hair. It helps my curls keep their shape a bit longer while still keeping flexibility. I plan to purchase again.

I have this from the salon and the one I ordered off of amazon- this product smells super chemically and the one that I bought at my local salon smells like watermelon. Will never order this product again, it is a knock off.
I love this product for beefing up a bun or ponytail. It does take a lot of product for fine hair and a can doesn’t go very far. The smell is great. Expensive.
I worked at a Regis salon and loved this product. They closed us but I couldn't find anything on the market that compares with this product. I have tried
I ordered 2 of this product. One can would not spray and half of the product was gone. I was supposed to get a replacement bottle but never did.

reviews.t: Picture is not the product received
reviews.x: The photo showed it was "firm hold" and I received "natural hold".  There is a big difference in the products.  This is not what I wanted.
This is the best hairspray for short fine hair I have ever used.  I"m  73 and do not care how much it cost if it does what i need .
I have short hair and have used this for years. It provides texture and body without stiffness. It’s never sticky.
Love this product. I have thin hair and this adds fullness without being heavy. You only need a little spray!

reviews.t: The product is over half empty and the spray nozzle does not spray.
reviews.x: I want a refund or send me another new one this time.  This is a used can of designline tousle.

reviews.t: One can of hairspray is defective. DOES NOT WORK.
reviews.x: I am very disappointed in this product. I have used this hairspray for years. Now the cans have been reduced to one/half the size of previous cans. I purchased the two cans as sold. One can works just fine, but the second can does not work. Cleaning the sprayer did not help. The can is defective. I would like a replacement. Thank you.

Unable to return for refund.  FYI I did re-order the correct hair spray.  Very disappointing.  I did try this - heat protectant for hair.  Sprayed on wet hair - couldn’t get a comb through my hair.  Instruction for use were not very good.  So disappointing.

reviews.t: The Only Hair Product I Buy!
reviews.x: I've used this for a good while and recently ordered it online because I couldn't find it at my salon. LOVE it, puts body in my fine hair. Not heavy and a nice fresh scent! I received it in a timely fashion, too. Thanks!
This was recommended to me by amazon as replacement for the Designline volumizing mousse...not at all as good. Has a strong smell. Might be fine for others needs though.

reviews.t: I live in Florida with so much humidity and this Hairspray keeps my hair from being frizzy at all!!
reviews.x: Literally the best Hairspray ever! To live in Florida and be able to have hair with no frizz that is still soft and free flowing is amazing!

reviews.t: Be careful how many you ordered.
reviews.x: I find it makes my  hair somewhat sticky or maybe I'm using too much.  Unfortunately I made a mistake and ordered 6 cans instead of three.

reviews.t: Clogs the nuzzle fast & Regis can’t seem to fix this problem
reviews.x: Clogs the nuzzle really fast. Nothing I can do will unstick the nuzzle. Regis needs to fix this cause it’s a damn great hairspray!

claims.text: Many reviewers love this product for fine or short hair, praising its hold and texture.
Several reviewers received the wrong hold (natural instead of firm) or a product that did not match the photo/description.
Some reviewers report packaging or quality problems, including clogged nozzles, defective cans, and a suspected knock-off with a chemical smell.
Reviewers appreciate that it provides flexible hold without leaving hair crunchy or stiff.
A few reviewers mention the product is expensive or that a can does not last long.
